Improved Epic support
Improved SteamVR runtime support
Improved Controller support and fixes
Improved logging and error reporting setup
Improved setup script to let you manually select runtime
Improved crosshair logic to be more consistent
Improved scripted scenes - your arms and hands now appear only while the game is
  actually animating them, instead of hanging frozen in your view
Improved scripted scenes - they now go where they are meant to, instead of being
  steered by where you were looking

Fixed health and plasmid HUD meters
Fixed multiple bugs in the binding INI configs
Fixed the crosshair showing when you are not holding anything
Fixed the camera shaking during normal play

Added uninstall script
Added support for WMR/Reverb controllers
Added manual weapon swing(Very Early and doesn't work great yet)
Added head based movement option
Added snap turn option
Added more binding options for swapping dpad layout
Added a real tracked free hand - the hand that is not holding your weapon now
  follows your own controller instead of being hidden, and turns with it
Added the same for your free hand while holding a plasmid
Added live in-headset tuning for hand position and rotation, saved automatically
